description: Client-side script for managing Journal Entry form in ERPNext, including setup, validation, currency handling, and related operations.

classes.name: erpnext.accounts.JournalEntry
classes.description: Controller class for Journal Entry form handling default loading, query setup, and balance formatting.

methods.name: onload
methods.description: Initialize default values, setup queries, and balance formatter when form loads.

methods.name: onload_post_render
methods.description: Set multiple add feature for accounts grid after form rendering.

methods.name: load_defaults
methods.description: Set default values for the form and accounts if new.

methods.name: setup_queries
methods.description: Configure query filters for account, party_type, and reference_name fields.

methods.name: reference_name
methods.description: Fetch and update outstanding amounts for referenced documents.

methods.name: get_outstanding
methods.description: Call server to get outstanding amount for a specific document.

methods.name: setup_balance_formatter
methods.description: Define custom formatter for account balances in the grid.

methods.name: from_template
methods.description: Populate form fields from a selected Journal Entry Template.

methods.name: make_inter_company_journal_entry
methods.description: Create a dialog to select company and generate inter-company journal entry.

methods.name: toggle_fields_based_on_currency
methods.description: Show or hide currency-related fields based on multi_currency setting.

methods.name: set_debit_credit_in_company_currency
methods.description: Calculate debit and credit in company currency based on exchange rate.

methods.name: set_exchange_rate
methods.description: Determine and set exchange rate for a row based on account currency and other factors.

methods.name: quick_entry
methods.description: Open a dialog for quick journal entry creation with debit and credit accounts.

methods.name: account_query
methods.description: Return filters for account selection based on company and multi_currency setting.

methods.name: reverse_journal_entry
methods.description: Create a reversed journal entry from the current one.
